narrative.overview:
FlagFlow is one world from the first pixel of the public home page (`apps/dashboard/src/landing/LandingPage.tsx`, the owner's binding visual reference) to the last toggle in the signed-in app. The ground is near-black ink. Content sits on slightly lifted near-black cards with white hairlines. One colour carries meaning: lime. It marks something that is on, the action that will make something go, and the thing that has focus. Nothing else is lime, so a glance at any screen tells you what is live.

The voice is bold and tight. Headlines are Inter Tight at weight 700, Title Case, with heavy negative tracking. Reading text is white at 55 to 60% opacity. Geist Mono shows up only for strings a person would copy into code. The home page carries the richest version of the world: a floating glass header, side rails, faint arcs, lime sparkles, and lime glows bleeding up from the lower corners. The auth pages drop the header and split into the form and a panel holding the owner's desk illustration, whose monitor mirrors the form. The signed-in shell keeps only the two corner glows, faint enough to work under.

Motion uses one exponential ease-out. Content rises a few pixels as it arrives, on-states settle in, and everything honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: Ink ground (#0b0d0c) with near-black cards and white hairlines at 6 to 12%.
Lime (#c4f04a) only for on, go and focus. Ink text on lime fills.
Flag state: Live lime, Testing iris, Inactive grey. Danger is flame.
Inter Tight bold Title Case headlines tracked -0.04 to -0.055em. Geist Mono only for keys and IDs.
Three radii: 9px controls, 16px panels, 20px cards. A 3px-rounded lime square is the mark.
Atmosphere is lime light, never violet or another hue.

rules.name: The Lime Is On Rule
rules.body: Lime means on, go or focus, and nothing else. Before making anything lime, name which of the three it is. If it is none of them, it is not lime.

rules.name: The Three States Rule
rules.body: Flag state has exactly three colours: Live lime, Testing iris (text #a59cff), Inactive grey. The off state is always labelled "Inactive". Flag state colour comes only through the state pill.

rules.name: The Flame Is Danger Rule
rules.body: Flame marks destructive actions and errors only. It is never decoration in the app.

rules.name: The Lime Light Rule
rules.body: Atmospheric light (corner glows, sparkles, the live dot's glow) is lime. No other hue is used for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Tight Title Rule
rules.body: Headlines are bold Title Case and tracked -0.04 to -0.055em. They balance-wrap and never go uppercase.

rules.name: The Machine Text Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is only for keys and IDs, meaning strings a person would copy into code. It is never used for headings, labels or decoration.

rules.name: The Glow Means On Rule
rules.body: The only component that glows is something that is on. Buttons and cards don't glow at rest.

rules.name: The Opaque Chrome Rule
rules.body: The app sidebar and drawer are opaque Sidebar Ink. Only the floating site header (white at 3.5%, medium blur) and the mobile app top bar are translucent.

rules.name: The Three Radii Rule
rules.body: Use 9px for controls, 16px for panels and 20px for cards. Other values are reference-page exceptions, not steps on the scale.

dos: Do make the whole product match the home page: ink ground, near-black cards, lime as the only signal.
Do use lime only for on, go and focus: the primary action, Live, the active nav item, focus, a ticked checkbox.
Do show flag state through the state pill: Live lime, Testing iris with #a59cff text, Inactive grey, and always call off "Inactive".
Do use flame (#ff5a24) for danger and errors only.
Do set headlines in Inter Tight bold Title Case, tracked -0.04 to -0.055em, with reading text at white 55 to 60%.
Do keep to three radii: 9px buttons, 16px panels, 20px cards.
Do give every auth page the two-section layout: form left, the mirroring illustration right, no site header.
Do keep a primary button neutral (white 6% fill, white 40% text) while it is disabled.
Do show landing photographs in greyscale, and give every shipped raster a `.webp.json` provenance sidecar (the four home photos are free-license stock).
donts: Don't make anything lime that is not on, go or focus, including decoration, headings or section labels in the app.
Don't use Geist Mono for headings, labels or decoration.
Don't introduce a violet, indigo or other hue as an accent or atmosphere. Iris is Testing only.
Don't make the app sidebar or drawer translucent.
Don't add a lime glow to buttons or cards. A glow means something is on.
